meta.name: migrate-memory
meta.description: Migrate legacy NanoClaw and Claude-native memory into the shared memory tree and provider-neutral standing instructions. Run after an update reports the shared-memory breaking change, or when a group still has .seed.md, legacy CLAUDE.md/CLAUDE.local.md, Claude auto-memory, or an unindexed imported-agent-memory.md. Triggers on "migrate memory", "legacy memory", "the agent forgot everything after the switch".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将旧版记忆迁移到共享记忆树和持久指令
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果升级后智能体记忆失效或仍有旧版记忆文件
copy.tagline_en: Migrate legacy memory to shared memory tree and standing instructions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your agent forgot everything after a shared-memory breaking change

howto.what: 安装后，当你说出触发词时，Claude 会执行旧记忆迁移：先把 .seed.md、CLAUDE.md、Claude 自动记忆等旧文件安全移到暂存区，再分类整理进共享 memory 树，生成源到目标的迁移报告，并支持回滚。
howto.when: 更新报告共享内存破坏性变更后，或组里仍有旧 .seed.md、CLAUDE.md 等未迁移文件时触发；说“迁移记忆”“旧记忆”等关键词也会触发。

say.text: 把 .seed.md 和 CLAUDE.md 合并进共享记忆
say.note: 将这些旧文件整理进 memory 树。

say.text: 切换后代理忘了所有事，请迁移旧记忆

howto.what_en: When triggered, Claude runs the legacy memory migration: it moves old files like .seed.md, CLAUDE.md, and Claude auto-memory into a staging area, then organizes them into the shared memory tree, produces a source-to-destination report, and supports rollback.
howto.when_en: Triggers after an update reports the shared-memory breaking change, or when a group still has old .seed.md, CLAUDE.md, or other unmigrated files; saying 'migrate memory', 'legacy memory', etc. also triggers it.

say_en.text: Merge .seed.md and CLAUDE.md into shared memory.
say_en.note: Moves these old files into the memory tree.

say_en.text: After the switch the agent forgot everything; please migrate.
